name: Magic Hour API Docs
description: Easily generate videos, images, and audio using Magic Hour's API. Follow our documentation to seamlessly integrate AI content creation into your applications.

skills.name: Magichour
skills.description: Use when building AI-powered video, image, or audio generation into applications. Reach for this skill when agents need to create videos (face swap, text-to-video, animation), generate images (from text, edit existing, swap faces), or synthesize audio (voice generation, voice cloning). Use for integrating asynchronous generation workflows, handling file uploads/downloads, setting up webhooks for production, or troubleshooting API calls.
